dynamicConfigs.name: Processing allowances
dynamicConfigs.description: Server-owned processing limits selected with the trusted service entitlement plan_key.

gates.name: Processing capture auto organization allowance bypass
gates.description: Allows a targeted service identity to exceed the capture auto-organization allowance. Keep false unless an expiring operator rule applies.

gates.name: Processing dish cover generation allowance bypass
gates.description: Allows a targeted service identity to exceed the dish cover-generation allowance. Keep false unless an expiring operator rule applies.

gates.name: Processing allowance emergency enforcement
gates.description: Globally forces allowance enforcement and takes precedence over both account bypass gates.
